description: Read the FUTURE SERVICE NOTE. view notice: the plain-words notice with its version and the hash a record must name. view terms: the open terms of outside providers, oldest first, each with the capacity left, the provider's price, the window and the hash a note names, never a wallet. view counts: how many terms and notes stand, and how many notes became orders, never a wallet. recordId: one set of terms or one note, with its status and why, never a wallet. With nothing passed, the notice is read. The program is held off until the operator switches it on, and until then the notice, the terms and the counts say so plainly; this tool moves no NET, and the house pays, holds and sells nothing through it. Free, keyless, nothing to sign. Cost and signer: free and keyless, nothing to sign.

recordId.description: One record's id (the id it was made under). A record that exists can be read at any time.

view.description: notice: the words a record names. terms: the open terms and the capacity left. counts: what stands.

name: net_future_service_status
title: Read the future service notice and its hash, the open terms, the counts, or one record by its id
